children: Finland's sustainable chemistry firm's Q3 revenue rose 3% yr/yr, mainly due to acquisitions
Q3 operative EBITDA fell 18% yr/yr, mainly due to raw material cost inflation
Q3 EPS dropped to EUR 0.21 from EUR 0.38 a year earlier
Kemira expects 2026 revenue between EUR 2.6 bln and EUR 3.0 bln
Kemira sees 2026 operative EBITDA in the range of EUR 400 mln to EUR 500 mln
Company says demand remains weak amid global economic uncertainty and volatile input costs
ACQUISITIONS - Q3 revenue growth was mainly driven by acquisitions, per CEO Antti Salminen
RAW MATERIAL COSTS - Higher raw material costs following the Middle East conflict weighed on profitability, per CEO Antti Salminen
SALES PRICES - Increased sales prices helped offset some cost inflation, but volumes declined yr/yr
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and 3 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the diversified chemicals peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Kemira Oyj is €18.00, about 11.1% above its October 22 closing price of €16.20
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
